wholePhysicalScope: Five-vertex mapped temple footprint, named site marker and two exact July 2024 aerial photographs from Qualla. Original Copernicus relief sampled before authoring.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the white ribbed sanctuary, attached entrance hall, red shrine and forecourt. Near levels add column bases, finials and doors.
limitations: The model represents the July 2024 sanctuary, attached entrance hall, nearby red shrine and terrace. Island vegetation, interior spaces, and separate lower campus buildings are outside scope.
Aerial images constrain roof colors, relative heights and forecourt arrangement. The red shrine and terrace positions, lower wall details and grade are estimates.
The native Copernicus DSM gives the original island relief at approximately 28 by 31 metre sample spacing. It does not resolve the smaller courtyards and steps.
